name: Assertivlogix Duplicate and Unused Media Cleaner
author: Assertiv Logix

sections.description:
Assertivlogix Duplicate and Unused Media Cleaner is a production-ready, premium WordPress plugin designed to help you keep your media library clean and efficient.

Key Features

  • Detect duplicate media files by hash comparison (md5 + sha1).
  • Find unused media not connected to posts, pages, or products.
  • Identify orphaned thumbnails and broken media references.
  • Modern React-based dashboard for scanning and managing results.
  • Scalable architecture for large sites (100k+ media files).
  • Licensed system ready for commercial distribution.
sections.installation:
1. Upload assertivlogix-duplicate-unused-media-cleaner folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Media Cleaner’ menu to start your first scan.
sections.faq:
Does it delete files automatically?

No, the plugin provides a list of findings for you to review and bulk-delete manually or via auto-clean rules.

Is it safe for WooCommerce?

Yes, it includes built-in compatibility for WooCommerce products and galleries.
